_doc: The tile size budget: the largest numbers that the tiles and the style can have (rust/roadstyle-rs/tests/tile_budget.rs; docs/design/tile_contract.md, 'The tile size standard'). Limits only go down: scripts/tile_budget.py. A raise needs --raise --why, is listed in `raises`, and the PR text must say why; Kaveh must agree.

raises.why: the first budget: the numbers of the engine at 5a4297b plus the margin
the reduction rules: each tile layer now has its rule numbers (unread keys, features without an id, text values, short segments, tiny features), and the budget has the lean and the full look

roads-simple paint.line-color: +428 characters (1,767 to 2,195 on the page's look): the style holds the class fill and casing colours once, as lookups by class index, in place of a colour text in each piece. The tiles lose the values (Monaco z15 simple: 2,103 to 66) and 5 % of their bytes; the style's total characters are lower than before.

New views and areas, no raise of an old limit. Zoom 9 to 11 views of Monaco and Tartu (the low zooms, where MapLibre needed 0.4 to 0.7 s for a Burnaby tile of 0.5 to 1.2 MB), and the areas monaco-base and tartu-base: the page's look with the area's base map (land, water, paved areas, buildings), which the golden looks left out and which is most of a low-zoom tile.
MLT entries (mlt_view_bytes, mlt_max_tile_bytes) added: new numbers, no old limit changes
MLT entries (mlt_view_bytes, mlt_max_tile_bytes) added: new numbers, no old limit changes

Zoom bands (2j): the road layer is three style layers (below z14, z14 to z15, from z15), each with the limits of the one layer. The style has two more layers, and its expressions grow because the paint is there three times (a band keeps only the zoom stops that it reads). The tiles do not change.

The dash (2f): the road layer keeps line-dasharray only in a layer of the dashed pieces (the tunnels' dashes and the pieces with a pattern), so each band has a second layer. The style has three more layers. The tiles do not change.

The dash (2f): the road layer keeps line-dasharray only in a layer of the dashed pieces (the tunnels' gaps and dashes and the pieces with a pattern), so each band has a second layer. The style has three more layers. The tiles do not change.
one road layer for every zoom: the zoom bands left the roads empty at z14/z15 (Kaveh agreed 2026-10-29)
New limit property_bytes (the bytes of the feature properties of the largest tile of a layer); it had no limit before. Not a raise of an existing limit.

Twin pairs: the fill pieces of a two-way pair have the flag __rs_pair (instead of __rs_twoway), so each direction is one half of the road (docs/design/twin_ends.md). A fill of a pair no longer has the same properties as a fill of a two-way road that is not a pair, so tile features of the two kinds do not merge: +4 % features and +4 % bytes in Monaco at z13 to z15. The line-offset expression is 4061 bytes (was 3033): it has a branch for the halves.

Tunnel factor of the 3D terrain (terrain_tunnels=): the one road layer's line-opacity multiplies every piece of a tunnel road by the state rs_terrain_tunnel, so the expression of roads-simple and roads-simple-dash is longer only in a style with tunnels (Monaco, Tartu)
